visualRisks.description: The path defined by the route [3,15,4,27,16,28,17,40,52,64,51,76,75,87,99,111,123] is not clearly visible or logical in the grid. There are no clear landmarks or changes in color that would help a player follow this path.
visualRisks.suggestion: Consider adding more visual cues like different colored tiles or symbols to indicate the path.

visualRisks.description: There are sections of the grid where there is no clear connection between them, such as from row 10 onwards. This could be confusing for players trying to navigate through the district.
visualRisks.suggestion: Ensure that all parts of the grid are interconnected and provide a clear path for navigation.

navigationRisks.description: The route provided does not clearly indicate directions or turns, making it difficult to navigate. For example, moving from row 3 to row 15 without any visual cues.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add directional indicators such as arrows or symbols that show the direction of movement.

navigationRisks.description: The grid layout seems inconsistent with some rows having more characters than others, which could lead to confusion. For instance, row 1 has only three characters while other rows have up to twelve.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Ensure that the grid is uniformly designed for better navigation and a smoother player experience.
